user.title: Where do you want outage alerts?
user.description: An outage is reported when it is in this postal code AND on this street. Leave the street empty to watch the whole postal code.

data_description.postcode: The four-digit postal code, for example 9000.
data_description.lookahead_days: How many days ahead to show planned works. 0 shows only outages happening right now. Fluvius publishes at most 14 days ahead.
data_description.resolved_hours: How long an outage stays visible after the power is back, with its details. 0 turns this off. Maximum 168 (a week).
data_description.street: The street name, without house number. The spelling may differ a little from how Fluvius writes it. An outage is only reported when it is in your postal code AND on this street. For several streets, separate them with commas.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Fluvius. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This location is already set up.
